name: DVGO with Reparameterized Rendering
aliases: Direct Voxel Grid Optimization with proposed reparameterized estimates
definition: A voxel-based radiance field rendering method where the original DVGO rendering algorithm is replaced by the proposed reparameterized estimate (Equation 4) to enable differentiable ray point sampling.
summary: DVGO with Reparameterized Rendering replaces standard volume integration with differentiable point sampling to reduce training costs by controlling sample counts, trading some quality for speed.
